question: If the radius of a sphere is 24 cm, then its surface area is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Surface area of a **sphere** = 4πr²

Given **radius (r)** = 24 cm

Surface area = 4 × π × (24)² = 4 × π × 576 = 2304π

**∴ The correct answer is 2304π cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Radius (r)** of the sphere = 24 cm

**Formula Used:**

**Surface Area** of a Sphere = 4πr²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d3bce74bc10c37c8da6ee27a6277ee3b510591491050974a9ed3b680920f144e.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Surface Area = 4 × π × (24)²

⇒ Surface Area = 4 × π × 576

⇒ Surface Area = 2304π cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 2304π cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of Sphere

The volume of a **sphere** is calculated using the formula V = (4/3)πr³.

Hemisphere Properties

For a **hemisphere**, the Curved Surface Area (CSA) is 2πr² and the Total Surface Area (TSA) is 3πr².

Radius vs Diameter

The **diameter** (d) is twice the **radius** (r), so d = 2r. Surface area can also be expressed as πd².</p
